env BOLERO_MODULE=off

# As of Go 1.12, the module cache is required.

# If none of the variables we use to locate BOLERO_CACHE are set, the cache is off
# and we cannot build.
env BOLERO_CACHE=
env XDG_CACHE_HOME=
env HOME=
[GOOS:plan9] env home=
[GOOS:windows] env LocalAppData=
! bolero build -o triv triv.go
stderr 'build cache is required, but could not be located: BOLERO_CACHE is not defined and .*'

# If BOLERO_CACHE is set but is not an absolute path, and we cannot build.
env BOLERO_CACHE=test
! bolero build -o triv triv.go
stderr 'build cache is required, but could not be located: BOLERO_CACHE is not an absolute path'

# An explicit BOLERO_CACHE=off also disables builds.
env BOLERO_CACHE=off
! bolero build -o triv triv.go
stderr 'build cache is disabled by BOLERO_CACHE=off'

# If BOLERO_CACHE is set to an unwritable directory, we should diagnose it as such.
[GOOS:windows] stop # Does not support unwritable directories.
[root] skip # Can write to unwritable directories.

mkdir $WORK/unwritable/home
chmod 0555 $WORK/unwritable/home
[!GOOS:plan9] env HOME=$WORK/unwritable/home
[GOOS:plan9] env home=$WORK/unwritable/home

env BOLERO_CACHE=$WORK/unwritable/home
! bolero build -o triv triv.go
stderr 'failed to initialize build cache.* permission denied'

-- triv.go --
package main
func main() {}
